function defaultStrict(
  value=1
){
  'use strict';
  return value;
}
function restStrict(
  ...values:number[]
){
  'use strict';
  return values.length;
}
function objectStrict(
  {value}:{value:number}
){
  'use strict';
  return value;
}
function arrayStrict(
  [value]:number[]
){
  'use strict';
  return value;
}
const arrowStrict=(
  value=1
)=>{
  'use strict';
  return value;
};
class StrictMethods {
  constructor(
    public value=1
  ){
    'use strict';
  }
  method(
    value=1
  ){
    'use strict';
    return value;
  }
}
const objectMethods={
  method(
    value=1
  ){
    'other directive';
    'use strict';
    return value;
  }
};
